description: Ban many users in a single call, intended for raid mitigation. SAFE BY DEFAULT: dry_run is true unless explicitly set to false, so call it first to preview the user IDs a real call would send to Discord, unchecked, then re-call with dry_run:false to actually ban them. Requires both the Ban Members and Manage Server permissions. Returns { dry_run, would_ban } for a preview, and { dry_run, banned, failed } with the user IDs after a real call; failed also lists users who were already banned. Discord rejects the whole call with an error if no user could be banned. Use discord_ban_member for a single ban with finer control.

delete_message_seconds.description: Also delete each user's messages from the last N seconds (0–604800, i.e. up to 7 days). Default 0.

dry_run.description: If true (default), returns the user IDs a real call would send, unchecked, and bans no one. Set false to actually ban.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the server audit log.

user_ids.description: Array of user IDs (snowflakes) to ban (max 200 per call, a Discord API limit).

name: discord_bulk_ban

banned.description: User IDs banned by this call.

dry_run.description: true for a preview: no one was banned.

failed.description: User IDs not banned, including users who were already banned.

would_ban.description: Dry run only: the user IDs a real call would send to Discord, unchecked.
